entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Support' to be connected to the right department.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I, uh, I need to return something. I bought a pair of cycling shoes a couple of months ago and... they just don't work for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a preference issue?
I guess it's how they fit. I've tried everything. I adjusted the cleats a dozen times, but no matter what I do, they give me terrible blisters on my heels after every ride. I just can't wear them.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our riders. Can I get your order number to pull up the details?

Yes, it's VF-88615. I know it's been a little while... I've been a VeloFit customer for years and I saved up for these. I just feel so disappointed and I really needed this money back if they're not going to work.
I understand your frustration completely. Let me just pull this up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the cycling shoes were delivered 76 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long? I was so worried I was too late. I hope you can still help me.
Not to worry at all. I've just checked our policy for standard items like these, and you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Really? Oh, thank you! That is such a relief. I was so stressed about this. Thank you, Alex.

You're very welcome. I'm happy we could get this sorted out for you. I'm generating a prepaid return label and I'll email it to you right now. Just pack the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives them, your refund will be issued.
That's perfect. I really appreciate your help. You've made my day.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
